subject: Renewal: compact roadmap demo — stakeholder heatmap & recording release
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@brightlogic.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Patel <evan.patel@velaris.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal: compact roadmap demo — stakeholder heatmap & recording release

Hi Hannah,

As we discussed in the renewal pipeline call, our execs have a very tight window for next week and have requested a compact 40–45 minute roadmap/demo during our QBR. They'll want a concise walkthrough focused on the expansion items we flagged (batching/cost controls + private deployment checklist).

Two quick asks on our side before we lock times:
1) Can you confirm which Redwood stakeholders should be present (product, solutions engineering, and one senior infra person ideally)? I can map BrightLogic attendees to your heatmap.
2) Our legal team requires explicit recording consent for exec-level meetings — can you confirm Redwood's stance on recording and whether you can provide a short runbook for what will be recorded (screenshare, Q&A, post-demo notes)?

I've attached our internal attendee list and a high-level one-pager about the expansion priorities (see attachment stub). If possible, propose 2–3 30–60 min slots next week with ET-friendly times.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lydia Chen
Head of Partnerships | BrightLogic
[Attachment: qbr_onepager_brightlogic.pdf (pdf, 128KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:02:18 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: compact roadmap demo — stakeholder heatmap & recording release

Team — forwarding BrightLogic's request. We need a compact plan (40–45m) and a short runbook about recording permissions for exec-level attendees. Initial thoughts:

- Presenters: Product (Marissa) to lead roadmap + prioritized expansion asks; Rishi to cover infra/quantization impacts (10–12m deep-dive); Monica for ops/runbook + support SLAs.
- Proposed slots (ET): Tue 2026-06-23 11:00–11:45, Wed 2026-06-24 14:00–14:45, Thu 2026-06-25 09:30–10:15 (notes: Thu slot is shorter window for execs).
- Recording: we should require explicit consent from external attendees before enabling recording. Also note we must scrub any customer PII from logs in the recording and mark parts that are internal-only if we need to discuss internal metrics.

I've attached a draft stakeholder heatmap and a pared-down runbook for this compact QBR. Please review and add any objections/suggestions inline. We should reply to Lydia by EOD with slots and a 1–2 sentence recording policy + the runbook as an attachment.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:30:05 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: compact roadmap demo — stakeholder heatmap & recording release

Agree with the lineup. A few technical notes to include in the runbook:

- Presenter order: Marissa (roadmap 12m) -> Rishi (infra implications 10m with 3–4 slides) -> Monica (operational runbook + follow-ups 8m) -> 10–12m live Q&A.
- For recordings: we should add a short slide at the start saying "Recording will capture screenshare and audio; no customer logs will be shown unless redacted." Recommend Rishi or I anonymize any telemetry screenshots; avoid raw request traces.
- Backup: if the infra presenter is required but unavailable, mark "Rishi backup: Marcus Lin" (cc Marcus on final invite if you want).

I added two bullets in demo_runbook_v1.md — one for recording consent language and one for the backup presenter. No objections to slots; Tue/Wed look best for me.

-rishi
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Lydia (and Evan),

Thanks for the context — appreciate the tight turnaround. We can do a compact 40–45 minute QBR/demo focused on the expansion priorities. Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue, 23 Jun 2026, 11:00–11:45 ET
- Wed, 24 Jun 2026, 14:00–14:45 ET
- Thu, 25 Jun 2026, 09:30–10:15 ET (short window for execs)

Recording policy (short): Redwood will record screen share and audio with explicit consent; recordings will not include unredacted customer logs or full request traces. If any telemetry or config screenshots are included, we will anonymize or redact identifiable data before sharing. By confirming a slot below you provide permission for Redwood to record the session for internal use and for sharing the edited recording with BrightLogic stakeholders. If BrightLogic requires additional redaction or legal copy, let us know and we can route to Contracts.

Attached is our compact demo runbook (demo_runbook_v1.md) and a stakeholder heatmap indicating suggested Redwood attendees. Action items for BrightLogic: send your attendee list mapped to the roles in the heatmap and confirm a preferred slot.

If you'd like an exec-only 20–25 minute briefing before the full demo, we can also offer Wed 24 Jun 09:00–09:25 ET — let me know.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
